name: How long does it take to resolve a pedestrian accident case?
description: Resolution times vary; minor cases can settle in months, while complex ones with serious injuries may take a year or more.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to resolve a pedestrian accident case?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for resolving a pedestrian accident case varies significantly depending on several factors, such as the complexity of the accident, the severity of injuries, the cooperation of insurance companies, and court schedules if a lawsuit is filed. Minor cases might settle in a few months, while more complex cases involving serious injuries or extensive negotiations can take a year or more. Your attorney will provide a more precise estimate after evaluating your specific situation and keeping you informed throughout the process.
